_comments.antigravity_native_note: Antigravity natively provides GitHub (gh plugin), Google Drive/Calendar plugins, filesystem tools (view_file/replace_file_content), and web search (google_search/browse). Do not enable duplicate MCP servers.
_comments.stitch_mcp_note: Antigravity reads global MCP configs from ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json and workspace MCP configs from .agents/mcp_config.json (.agent/mcp_config.json). Because Antigravity does not expand ${VAR} in JSON headers, keep real X-Goog-Api-Key values strictly in gitignored/personal configs.
_comments.context_budget_note: Keep total enabled MCP servers under 10 to preserve context window and avoid payload bloat.
_comments.full_catalog: See .agent/mcp/mcp-servers.catalog.json for all 34 verbatim ECC MCP configurations.
